_comment: Release toolchain pin (release audit B2/F2). A release build must be reproducible from
the public commit alone, so the publish script REFUSES to build unless the resolved
toolchain matches these values EXACTLY -- by identity (file hashes), not just by
version string: a prefix comparison used to accept '18.9.10' and even '18.9.1evil',
and a version number does not identify the bytes that actually compile the product.
Changing any value is a deliberate re-pin: edit here, rebuild, and re-verify
byte-identical reproduction from two fresh clones before shipping.
sdkVersion is additionally enforced by global.json (rollForward: disable); the runtime
pack patch by UI.csproj (KnownRuntimePack). runtimeFrameworkVersion and
windowsAppSdkVersion here are EXPECTATIONS: Build-LicenseInventory.ps1 cross-checks
them against the artifact's own deps.json and resolved graph and fails on a mismatch,
so an edited pin can no longer be copied into BUILDINFO unchallenged.
The NuGet graph is recorded per release in LICENSE-INVENTORY.md, including each
package's content hash, and that file's SHA-256 goes into BUILDINFO.
